pilots.name: MERIDIAN VS-02 Roster to shift cover
pilots.process_kpi: Overtime and agency hours per 1,000 handled units

pilots.name: MERIDIAN VS-01 Bid to contract renewal
pilots.process_kpi: Win rate on renewals; days from bid request to signed contract
interview_prompts: CAP-04.People People is Early: Structure defined but pricing, revenue management, and bid-solution architect roles not yet visibly staffed. Watch: Fewer than 3 specialist offers accepted by end of quarter → bench gap persists, hold L2 and flag to board

CAP-04.Process Process is Emerging: CRM programme commenced; contract-lifecycle system underway; multi-year EBITDA uplift targeted. Watch: CRM adoption below 60% at 90 days post-launch → flip trajectory down (adoption gap predicts stall)

principles.text: Decisions are made at the station, by one named role.
principles.refuted_by: Event records showing a different role deciding in more than one case in five.

principles.text: Standard work is written once and run everywhere.
principles.refuted_by: Three or more routes for the same step across shifts.

principles.text: AI takes the rule-based work; people keep the judgement.
principles.refuted_by: An automated step that still needs a person to correct it most days.

principles.text: Capability is built ahead of growth, not after it.
principles.refuted_by: Anchor seats still absent two cycles after a growth decision.
